hooks.command: [ -f ~/.claude/sounds/.enabled ] && files=(~/.claude/sounds/*.mp3) && afplay "${files[RANDOM % ${#files[@]}]}" || true
git -C ~/projects/devconfig status --porcelain agents 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && echo 'devconfig/agents has uncommitted changes - run agent-sync' || true
~/.claude/hooks/block-dangerous.sh
~/.claude/hooks/block-git-writes.sh

if [ -n "${HOME-}" ] && [ -f "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -r "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -x "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ]; then ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID="${PPID:-}"; export ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID; /bin/sh "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh"; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi
